title: outbox: MAX_DELIVERY_ATTEMPTS condition uses >= MAX-1 which is opaque
description: kith-store/src/outbox.rs:9,150 — MAX_DELIVERY_ATTEMPTS = 72, but the check is attempt >= MAX_DELIVERY_ATTEMPTS - 1. The intent is 'fire on the 72nd attempt (0-indexed attempt_count of 71)', but the expression requires mental subtraction. A clearer approach: rename the constant to MAX_DELIVERY_ATTEMPTS: i64 = 72 and check attempt >= MAX_DELIVERY_ATTEMPTS - 1, or introduce a LAST_DELIVERY_ATTEMPT_INDEX constant = MAX_DELIVERY_ATTEMPTS - 1 with a comment.
